name: Carna Biosciences,Inc.
summary: Carna Biosciences, Inc., established in Kobe, Japan, in 2003, is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company discovering and developing new drugs aimed at major unmet medical needs, with a focus on Japan. It also offers research tools such as kinase proteins, substrates and kinase assay products. One candidate is in Phase 1 trials for inflammatory and immune disorders, and AS-1763, an oral non-covalent inhibitor, is in preclinical development.
